articles.title: What It Takes to Be Free
articles.highlight: 我们生活在一个扭曲了权力意义与尺度的文化中，把可见性混同于价值，把地位混同于实质，把关注混同于爱。
articles.summary: 文章追问人如何找到自己的力量与自由，并指出这并不容易：文化误导了我们对权力和价值的衡量，而自由意志本身也可能是幻觉。出身、时代、身体、生化条件、相遇与爱情中的偶然，构成了人生的大多数牌面。值得读的地方在于，它不把自由当成口号，而是先呈现自由要面对的真实约束。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键提醒是：谈自由不能只靠意志口号，先看清文化误导与偶然性约束，再谈如何守住自主。
articles.sourceExcerpt: We spend our lives trying to find our power and our freedom. It is not easy: We live in a culture that has distorted the meaning and measure of power, confusing visibility with value, status with substance, attention with love; we live in a universe where free will may be an illusion, where chance deals the vast majority of the cards — the family and epoch we are born into, the body and biochemistry we live in, the people we cross paths with, the accidents of chemistry and happenstance we call love. The great double-edged question is how to keep… read article

With a few thousand neurons and sub-milliwatt power consumption, insects reliably classify odours in open environments.

articles.title: leemysw/yovoice
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 这是一个在 GitHub 上获得约 1954 星的开源项目，为 macOS 与 Windows 提供本地化的 AI 音频与音乐创作环境，功能包括语音合成、语音克隆、带歌词的歌曲生成以及多轨乐谱。它最大的卖点是完全离线运行，且不产生 API 调用费用，因此直接回应了创作者在隐私、成本和网络依赖上的顾虑。对非技术决策者来说，它代表了一种“把生成式能力装进本地软件”的产品路径，值得观察它能否从开源仓库成长为可持续的工具。
articles.failureAnalysis: 完全离线意味着把模型推理放到用户设备上，容易受到显存、CPU 和安装包体积的严格限制，中低端设备体验可能明显变差；同时 Windows 与 macOS 双平台的分发、驱动兼容和模型更新，会持续消耗维护成本。语音克隆天然面临声音权属、deepfake 滥用与各地合规风险，一旦被用于伪造他人声音，项目可能遭遇下架或法律压力。商业上，它既要面对 ElevenLabs、Suno 等成熟付费产品的功能竞争，又缺乏 API 收费这一变现途径，仅靠社区贡献很难长期支撑。真正需要验证的是用户是否愿意为“离线”这一特性牺牲效果与便利，而目前只有星标数，尚缺少留存和付费意愿的证据。
articles.highlight: 开源本地 AI 音频与音乐工作室，覆盖 TTS、语音克隆、歌词歌曲与多轨乐谱，100% 离线、零 API 费用。

en.highlight: Open-source local AI audio and music studio for macOS and Windows with TTS, voice cloning, songs with lyrics and multi-track scores, 100% offline and zero API fees.
en.summary: This GitHub project, with roughly 1,954 stars, offers a local AI audio and music creation environment for macOS and Windows, covering text-to-speech, voice cloning, lyric-based songs and multi-track scores. Its main pitch is fully offline operation with no API costs, which speaks directly to creators' concerns about privacy, spend and network dependency. For a non-technical decision maker, it illustrates the product path of packaging generative capability into local software.
en.failureAnalysis: Running models entirely on-device caps quality by the user's GPU and disk, and dual-platform distribution plus model updates create ongoing maintenance cost. Voice cloning also carries voice-rights, deepfake and regulatory risk, while free offline use offers no clear revenue path against commercial rivals.
en.title: yovoice: an open-source, fully offline AI audio and music studio
